title: Floating Purple Mage
description: A young woman with white hair in an elaborate updo is captured mid-air against a solid gray background, seemingly falling or floating. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with armor-like accents, her body arched with one arm raised and legs bent, surrounded by floating purple crystalline shards and glowing magical effects.
prompt: A young East Asian woman with long white hair tied in an ornate bun with beads, wearing a white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with armored plates and wraps, is captured dynamically floating and falling in mid-air. Her body is arched, one arm extended upward and legs bent, surrounded by shattered glowing purple crystal fragments and magical energy wisps. Solid neutral gray background, dramatic lighting, clean digital anime-influenced illustration style.
